name: whisperx-core
description: WhisperX C++ engine core — ONNX Runtime + sherpa-onnx reimplementation of the WhisperX pipeline (see docs/cpp-core-handoff.md).
$notes: sherpa-onnx is not yet in the vcpkg registry; it is vendored / built from source when the ASR/VAD/diarize stages land (Phases 2/4). The light deps (nlohmann-json, pybind11, catch2) are also pulled via CMake FetchContent so a fresh checkout builds without a vcpkg bootstrap; pass the vcpkg toolchain file to resolve them (and the heavy deps) from vcpkg instead.
